camel_example: aliyun ens PutBucketLifecycle --region cn-hangzhou --Status Enabled --BucketName test
description_en: You can call the PutBucketLifecycle operation to set lifecycle rules for a bucket
description_zh: 调用PutBucketLifecycle设置文件生命周期规则
kebab_example: aliyun ens put-bucket-lifecycle --bucket-name test --status Enabled --region cn-hangzhou
name: PutBucketLifecycle

parameters.help_en:
A unique ID that identifies the rule. Maximum length is 255 bytes.

Omit this parameter when creating a new rule. The system generates a unique ID automatically.

Specify RuleId when updating an existing rule. The rule must exist. Otherwise, the call fails
parameters.help_zh:
标识规则的唯⼀ID。最多由255个字节组成。

创建新规则时无需配置该参数，系统会⾃动⽣成⼀个唯⼀ID。

更新已有规则需指定RuleId，且该RuleId对应的规则必须存在，否则会报错
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the rule. Valid values:

Enabled: The system runs the rule on schedule.

Disabled: The system ignores the rule
parameters.help_zh:
规则状态。取值范围：

Enabled：定期执⾏该规则。

Disabled：忽略该规则
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The prefix that the rule applies to. You cannot set duplicate prefixes.

If you specify a prefix, the rule applies only to objects in the bucket whose names start with that prefix.

If you leave Prefix empty, the rule applies to all objects in the bucket
parameters.help_zh:
指定规则所适⽤的前缀（Prefix），不⽀持设置相同的Prefix。

如果指定了Prefix，则表示此规则仅适⽤于Bucket中与Prefix匹配的Object。

如果Prefix置空，则表示此规则适⽤于Bucket中所有Object
parameters.name: prefix

parameters.help_en:
The date before which objects expire. The system applies the lifecycle rule to objects last modified before this date.

Use ISO 8601 format and UTC time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

ExpirationDays and CreatedBeforeDate are mutually exclusive. Specify one
parameters.help_zh:
指定过期⽇期，存储会对最后更新时间早于该⽇期的数据执⾏⽣命周期规则。

⽇期设置需按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

ExpirationDays和CreateBeforeDate互斥，必须设置⼀个
parameters.name: created_before_date

parameters.help_en:
The number of days after an object's last modification when the lifecycle rule takes effect. Must be a positive integer greater than zero.

ExpirationDays and CreatedBeforeDate are mutually exclusive. Specify one
parameters.help_zh:
指定⽣命周期规则在距离Object最后更新多少天后⽣效。取值需大于0，为正整数。
ExpirationDays和CreateBeforeDate互斥，必须设置⼀个
parameters.name: expiration_days

parameters.help_en:
Whether to allow overlapping prefixes. Valid values:

true: Overlapping prefixes are allowed.

false (default): Overlapping prefixes are not allowed
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许前缀重叠。取值：

true：允许重复。

false（默认值）：不允许重复
parameters.name: allow_same_action_overlap
